name: localreceive
description: Ultra-Fast Local Network (LAN) AirDrop & Peer-to-Peer File Sharing

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix web
scripts.setup: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix web && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix web && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('web/dist', 'server/public', {recursive: true})" && npm run build --prefix server
